name: turing-mirror-page
description: Static homepage for www.turingmirror.com deployed with Cloudflare Pages.

scripts.dev: npm run build && wrangler pages dev dist --ip 127.0.0.1 --port 4174
scripts.check: node --check public/site.js && node --check public/boot.js && node scripts/build.mjs
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name turing-mirror-page
